latHint: Think threading in and out - not a slithering reptile.
pivHint: A SNAKE slithers along the ground - but to SNAKE through traffic means to do what?
winText: In and out. SNAKE was the pivot - a reptile to WEAVEing through traffic.
lossText: WEAVE - to move in and out. SNAKE was the pivot: a slithering SNAKE to SNAKING through traffic.
